# pqp

> pqp (pqp.gg) is an open-source voice and text chat for groups of friends, in the shape of Discord: servers with text and voice channels, DMs, friends, screen share and watch parties. It is written in Brazilian Portuguese first, runs in the browser, on desktop (Electron), on iOS (TestFlight beta) and on Android (APK beta), and the whole thing is AGPL on GitHub so anyone can run their own instance.

pqp is a small, independently run product. There is no public or agent-facing API: every endpoint on api.pqp.gg needs a signed-in user session, and the only things on this host an agent can read without one are the pages listed below. Public profile pages (`/@handle`) and community pages (`/c/slug`) exist, but they are not enumerable from here: a person or a community is found because somebody shares the link.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://pqp.gg/): what pqp is and how to start
- [pqp vs Discord](https://pqp.gg/vs-discord): the comparison page
- [Screen share](https://pqp.gg/tela): sharing a screen with sound from the browser
- [Claim your @](https://pqp.gg/garanta): how a public handle works
- [Blog and release notes](https://pqp.gg/blog): what shipped, week by week
- [iOS beta](https://pqp.gg/beta): TestFlight
- [Android beta](https://pqp.gg/android): direct APK
- [Desktop download](https://pqp.gg/download): Electron builds
- [Status](https://pqp.gg/status): live service status
- [Support the project](https://pqp.gg/apoie): donations; nothing is unlocked by donating
